(async()=>{const files=rocksy.tree.entries.filter(e=>!e.isDir&&/\.md$/i.test(e.path));const blocks=[];for(const e of files){const f=await T.inv('read_file',{path:T.vault(...e.path.split('/'))});const re=/^```mermaid[^
]*?
([\s\S]*?)?
```/gm;let m;while((m=re.exec(f.text)))blocks.push({path:e.path,src:m[1]})}const by={};for(const b of blocks){const type=b.src.trim().split(/\s+/)[0];const r1=await rocksy.renderMermaid(b.src);const r2=await rocksy.renderMermaid(b.src);const o=by[type]||(by[type]={blocks:0,ok:0,firstMs:[],warmMs:[],errors:[],files:[]});o.blocks++;if(r2.ok)o.ok++;else o.errors.push(r2.error);o.firstMs.push(r1.ms);o.warmMs.push(r2.ms);o.files.push(b.path)}window.__mm=by;const out={};for(const k in by){const o=by[k];out[k]={blocks:o.blocks,ok:o.ok,firstMs:o.firstMs,warmMs:o.warmMs,errors:o.errors.slice(0,2)}}return JSON.stringify({files:files.length,blocks:blocks.length,byType:out})})()

(async()=>{const fs=window.__mm['sequenceDiagram'].files;await T.open(T.vault(...fs[0].split('/')));const want="sequenceDiagram";const t=T.text();let i=-1;for(;;){i=t.indexOf('```mermaid',i+1);if(i<0)break;if(t.slice(i,i+60).includes(want))break}const n=T.show(i<0?'```mermaid':i);await T.wait(()=>T.count('.cm-lp-mermaid-body svg')>0||T.count('.cm-lp-mermaid-body.is-error')>0,6000);await new Promise(r=>setTimeout(r,400));return JSON.stringify({line:n,svgs:T.count('.cm-lp-mermaid-body svg'),errors:[...document.querySelectorAll('.cm-lp-mermaid-body.is-error')].map(e=>e.textContent.slice(0,120))})})()
